engine.rationale: The design is drawn for 2D and declares pixijs. The play happens on a flat ice-grid plane: a sliding puzzle needs no depth to read, and 2D with vector art keeps the first load small on portal traffic, where time to first play decides whether the player stays.

architecture.rendering: pixijs (2d) through the template's renderer seam (createRenderer, @wgf/pixi-framework); no other engine is loaded.
architecture.physics: Custom collision and overlap tests in src/game/, engine-free and unit testable; no physics dependency. A simulation library is a superseding tech-plan decision at G3, never development's.
architecture.game_core: Template packages/game-core: loop, scenes, events, pause. Game states and mechanics from the design's build_spec live in src/.
architecture.state: Game state machine from build_spec.game_states, in src/; persistence through the platform storage abstraction.
architecture.input: build_spec.controls mapped onto the template's input handling.
architecture.ui: Screens, HUD and menus from build_spec, rendered with the selected engine.
architecture.audio: Template audio slot; content per the design's audio direction.
architecture.assets: The asset-manifest under public/assets/; the bundle stays within 150 MB.
architecture.platform_sdk: @wgf/platform-sdk only; the adapter is chosen from game.config.yaml platforms, never by game code.
architecture.persistence: platform storage (cloud where the profile allows, local otherwise).

tasks.title: Implement Ice board
tasks.description: A grid of ice tiles bounded by walls and rocks that a slide stops against.
acceptance_criteria: The board is between 6x6 and 9x9 depending on the level, and every cell is ice, wall, rock, or the goal.
Every authored board is solvable inside its move cap, and the level data stores that solution's length.
Strategy MVP: 6 designed levels with authored difficulty on depth, move-limit, board-complexity, piece-variety.

tasks.title: Implement Directional slide
tasks.description: A tapped or swiped direction sends the penguin sliding cell by cell until it hits a wall, a rock, a closed door, or the board's edge.
acceptance_criteria: The penguin moves every open cell in the chosen direction and stops in the last cell before whatever blocks it.
A slide costs one move whether it travels one cell or the whole board.
Choosing a direction the penguin cannot move in (blocked on the very first cell) costs no move.

tasks.title: Implement Goal tile
tasks.description: A marked exit tile; the penguin stopping on it clears the level.
acceptance_criteria: The penguin's slide ending exactly on the goal tile clears the level immediately.
The goal tile is visually distinct from ice, wall, rock, key, door and crumbling tiles at a glance.

tasks.title: Implement Move budget and stars
tasks.description: Each level carries a par move count and a hard move cap; reaching the goal inside the cap wins, and how close to par decides one to three stars.
acceptance_criteria: Every slide decrements the level's moves-left counter by one.
Reaching the goal with moves-left at or above the level's 3-star threshold awards three stars; lower thresholds award two or one.
Moves-left reaching zero before the goal is reached fails the level and offers an immediate retry on the same board.
Strategy MVP: Core loop: read the level, plan the moves, solve it, advance to a harder level that adds a rule or tightens the budget.
Strategy MVP: The brief, built in full: A sliding-ice puzzle: a penguin slides until it hits something; 24 hand-designed levels with keys, doors, crumbling tiles and a 3-star move target.

tasks.title: Implement Keys and doors
tasks.description: A key tile is collected the instant the penguin's slide crosses or stops on it; a door of the matching colour then opens and no longer blocks a slide.
acceptance_criteria: The penguin crossing or stopping on a key tile removes that key from the board and marks it collected in the HUD.
A door blocks a slide like a wall until its matching key is collected, after which it is open for the rest of the attempt.
A door with no matching key yet collected cannot be crossed or stopped on.

tasks.title: Implement Crumbling tile
tasks.description: An ice tile that crumbles into a hole the instant the penguin's slide crosses it; a hole ends the attempt if the penguin crosses or stops on it again.
acceptance_criteria: The first time a slide passes over or stops on a crumbling tile, it turns into a hole for the rest of the attempt.
A slide that would cross or stop on a hole fails the level immediately, with an immediate retry offered.
A crumbling tile's crumbled (hole) state is visually unmistakable from its intact state.

tasks.title: Implement Game flow
tasks.description: Boot, loading, title, play, pause and the result card, wired as build_spec.game_states.
acceptance_criteria: First session reaches play within 5s of load on a mid-range phone.
Retry from the result card starts a new level within 2s.
Pause on tab hidden; resume only on player input.

tasks.title: Implement Kill and success criteria telemetry
tasks.description: Emit the measurements the strategy's criteria read, so G4 is decided on data.
acceptance_criteria: Records `first_time_understood_share` for criterion control_not_understood.
Records `unprompted_retry_share` for criterion no_retry_pull.
Records `prototype_elapsed_days` for criterion prototype_overran.
Records `midrange_mobile_fps` for criterion mobile_performance_floor.
Records `d1_retention` for criterion d1_retention.
Records `median_session_seconds` for criterion session_length.

tasks.title: Implement Platform integration
tasks.description: Platform SDK init, loading progress, ads, cloud save and the other build_spec.sdk_touchpoints, through the template's platform abstraction.
acceptance_criteria: Each required touchpoint fires at its stated moment in a local platform-SDK mock.
No portal SDK is called directly from game code.
Strategy MVP: Poki SDK: init, loading-progress, gameplay-start-stop, rewarded, interstitial, pause-audio-during-ads.

tasks.title: Implement Localization
tasks.description: UI strings in en, ru, kept under 40 strings to make human translation cheap.
acceptance_criteria: Every UI string resolves in en, ru; no hard-coded text.
Strategy MVP: Localization: en, ru.

tasks.title: Implement Rewarded placement
tasks.description: On failing a level, offer five extra moves once per attempt
acceptance_criteria: Offered only in state level-fail.
The continue button is not shown; retry is the primary action. Never a disabled button.
Strategy MVP: A rewarded placement at a natural moment in the loop (continue or bonus), never forced.

tasks.title: Implement Interstitial placement
tasks.description: When the player leaves the result card (Retry or Menu), at most once every 180s, never in the first level of a session and never inside play
acceptance_criteria: Offered only in state level-fail.
Proceed immediately; no placeholder, no countdown.
Strategy MVP: Interstitials between sessions only, never inside one.

tasks.title: Implement Score and personal best, persisted locally
tasks.description: Committed in the title strategy MVP: Score and personal best, persisted locally.
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrable in the prototype build: Score and personal best, persisted locally.
Covered by at least one smoke-test step.

tasks.title: Implement Double-key door
tasks.description: A door that needs two different coloured keys collected before it opens, reusing key-door at higher piece-variety.
acceptance_criteria: A double-key door stays closed until both of its matching keys are collected in the same attempt.
Collecting one of its two keys is reflected in the HUD so the player knows which is still missing.

tasks.title: Implement Level select map
tasks.description: A map of all 24 levels, each showing its stars earned; any cleared level can be replayed, keeping the best star result.
acceptance_criteria: Replaying a level and scoring fewer stars never lowers the stars already recorded for it.
The map shows the running star total out of 72.

tasks.title: Implement Star totals
tasks.description: A running count of stars earned out of 72, shown on the level map and the title screen.
acceptance_criteria: 'Star totals' behaves as the game-design scope states; the design gives no finer acceptance criteria
